description: Andhra Pradesh to roll out ‘AI Doctor’ services linked to digital health records, offering free, AI-powered medical advice to 5 crore residents from 2026.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Govt To Launch ‘AI Doctor’ Across The State; Free Digital Health Advice For 5 Crore Residents Andhra Pradesh to roll out ‘AI Doctor’ services linked to digital health records, offering free, AI-powered medical advice to 5 crore residents from 2026. The Andhra Pradesh government has announced a major digital push in the healthcare sector with the introduction of an “AI Doctor" service aimed at improving medical access across the state.
